purpose: Structured UI projection of Brew’s current canonical-runtime consolidation plan and evidence gates. This is navigation state, not runtime or merge authority.
authority_rule: Current Brew repository/PR source, exact local workspace revision, runtime evidence, CI, and project-owned checkpoints outrank this projection.

nodes.title: One reasoning agent and canonical runtime
nodes.summary: PR #442 consolidates Brew around one persistent reasoning agent while deterministic runtime owners retain execution, policy, state, and evidence responsibilities.

nodes.title: Canonical provider-backed text turn
nodes.summary: A real /query path reached LM Studio qwen/qwen3-vl-8b and returned a model response through Brew’s canonical runtime.

nodes.title: P0 operation-correlation boundary
nodes.summary: The earliest identity-loss boundary was traced to createProviderAdapter(generateResponse) output handoff; brew/runner/brew-runner.mjs was established as the patch owner.

nodes.title: P1 operation correlation
nodes.summary: Fresh canonical runtime evidence showed all model lifecycle events carried the exact /query operationId with WRONG_OPERATION_ID_COUNT=0.

nodes.title: P2 canonical Session / Turn / Item lifecycle
nodes.summary: Investigation only: map active producers, stores, callers, consumers, persistence roots, duplicate authorities, and one real /query persistence path before mutation.

nodes.title: Canonical durable turnId semantics
nodes.summary: Unproven. Do not invent a global turnId merely because an event schema exposes the field.

nodes.title: Provider tool call → host execution → continuation
nodes.summary: Live provider-native tool call, governed host execution, receipt, provider continuation, and ordered durable item evidence remain unproven.

nodes.title: Cancellation and restart recovery
nodes.summary: Cancellation/error attribution and crash/restart/resume exactly-once behavior remain unproven.

nodes.title: Dynamic tools, Browser and Telegram E2E
nodes.summary: Dynamic tool reuse, browser E2E, and Telegram account delivery E2E remain unproven.

nodes.title: Installed runtime, CI and release acceptance
nodes.summary: PR #442 remains draft and diverged from main. Installed-runtime acceptance and full current-head CI/release acceptance are not proven.
